description:
Dear Viewer , 

Attention please ! Must watch if you have own A Bike or Car .

This video is clarify the all confusion related own damage bike insurance or own damage car insurance .

In this video , we cleared the many points regarding own damage insurance .

Points to be given bellow !

1. kya own damage insurance renew karwana compulsory hai ?
2. own damage insurance ko expire huye 6 mahine ya 1 saal ho gya hai tho kya ab usko renew kiya ja sakta hai ?
3. agar third party insurance valid hai , tho kya own damage insurance lena thik rahega ?
4. own damage insurance main bike ya car chori ho jati hai , tho kya claim milega .
5. own damage insurance expire ho gya , lakin third party insurance valid hai , tho kya own damage insurance lena chahaye ya third party se kaam chal jayega .
6. kya own damage insurance lete wakt insurance company change kar sakte hain ?
7. bike ya car ka third party insurance valid hai , lakin own damage insurance nahi hai tho kya police challan kar sakti hai ? 
8. police challan se bachne ke liye konsa insurance sahi rahega ?
9. bike ka 5 saal ka insurance mila hua hai , uske bad kya own damage insurance lena chahaye ya nahi ?
10. bike ka 5 saal ka third party insurance hai , tho kya har saal own damage insurance lena hoga ya nahi ?
11. own damage insurance expire hone ke kitne bad usko renew kiya ja sakta hai ?
12. own damage insurance ka premium kab tak bharna hoga ?
13. own damage insurance ke bina drive karna legal ya illegal ?
14. own damage insurance par claim karne par kya koi paisa pay karna hota hai ?
15. own damage insurance renew karwana kitna jaruri hai ?
16. own damage insurance ke sath zero depth plan le sakte hain ?

Thanks & Regards
krishan kumar
